91)bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i brgyud 'debs ni/khyab bdag ston pa kun bzangache ba'i mchog/rdo rje sems dpa' zhi khro bka' brgyad lha/ /rdo rja

tei:div.tei:p: bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i brgyud 'debs ni/ khyab bdag ston pa kun bzangache ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' zhi khro bka' brgyad lha// rdo rje 'chang chen shāka thub dga' rab la// gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// gsang chen bka' yi sdud po rdo rje chos// mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo las kyi dbang mo che// skal ldan mchog rab ind+ra bhu ti la// gsol ba= mi slob zung 'jug mngon gyur shrī seng ha// bde chen sgyu ma'i gar mkhan gāo ma sa// 'dzam gling rgyan mchog dpal gyi rig 'dzin brgyad// gsol ba= rab 'byams rgyal kun ngo bo padma 'byung*// gangs can bstan pa'i nyin byed grub chen brgyad// chos rgyal tshangs pa lha yi me tog la// gsol ba= zab gter bstan pa'i spyi mes mnga' bdag nyang*// mi skyod dga' ba'i dbyangs can rdo rje 'chang*// grub brgya'i 92)spyi dpal gu ru chos kyi dbang*// gsol ba= rig 'dzin gtso bo ku ma ra dza dang*// kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po klong chen pa// 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal 'byor rgya mtsho'i zhabs// gsol ba= padma'i 'od zer phan bde'i dpal dang ldan// dbang gi rgyal po dngos grub dpal gyi 'byor// mthu stobs brtul zhugs mthar phyin ratna'i mtshan// gsol ba= ngag gi dbang phyug 'dzam gling yongs la grags// blo gros mchog gis bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'chang*// gzhan phan phrin las mthar phyin rdo rje 'dzin// gsol ba= kun bzang gdung 'tshob phrin las lhun gyis grub// padma gar dbang 'gyur med rdo rje rtsal// shes rab mthar phyin ratna bī dza ya// gsol ba= grub gnyis nor bu'i mdzod mnga' shrī na tha// snga 'gyur bstan pa'i nyi ma 'jigs med gling*// grub pa'i dbang phyug kun bzang gzhan phan zhabs// gsol ba= kun bzang gdod ma'i mgon po a bha ya// padma'i 93) ring lugs mdo sngags bstan pa 'dzin// thub bstan snang byed chos kyi nyi ma la// gsol ba=

dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag chos kyi rje// smin grol gdams pa'i bdud rtsi mchog sbyin mkhan// bka' drin mnyam med rtsa brgyud bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so= phyi dkyil smin byed lam gyis lha skur shar// lus dkyil dbang gis rtsa khams bde drod 'bar// phyag rgya la brten dga' bzhi'i ye shes rtogs// rang sems ka dag kun bzang mngon gyur shog / ces rgyal khams pa 'gyur med rdo rjes so/ brgyud pa'i khyad par kha bsgyur padma ma ṇis so// dge'o// 94)
